class.name: VolumetricCloudEffect
class.brief_description: Single-layer volumetric clouds with sparse temporal or complete half-resolution tracing.
class.description: Renders a spherical cloud layer after the sky and before transparent geometry in Forward+. By default, trace dimensions are ceil(viewport / 4), temporal reconstruction dimensions are ceil(viewport / 2), followed by depth-guided composition. Each traced tile retains its minimum and maximum opaque depth and integrates both near-clipped and far cloud radiance in one primary march. Paired temporal histories preserve these depth choices during upsampling. This is a native RenderingDevice effect, separate from whole-frame TAA. Requires perspective projection and HDR storage buffers; unsupported renderers are skipped safely. With [member complete_tracing], every ceil(viewport / 2) sample is traced each frame and no previous color is reused. Near/far integration and depth-guided composition remain active. Midpoint quadrature and a longitudinal footprint increasing from 0.35 to 1.0 steps over 8 to 24 km reduce screen-locked grain and distant undersampling. This increases trace ray count about fourfold and requires larger trace textures; it is not Mode 0. Cloud scattering is single-scattering with short sunlight shadow marches and height-dependent ambient fill. There are no regional clouds, ground cloud shadows, multiple-scattering octaves, or reflected cloud capture. Cloud history is independent per viewport and eye. A camera cut, viewport resize, or [method reset_history] rejects old history. Cloud radiance is not automatically included in Sky radiance/IBL. Lighting colors are linear values. The world uses meters with planet center at (0, -planet_radius, 0). [member sun_direction] points toward the sun. Supply the atmospheric illumination at cloud altitude, before local foreground fog attenuation. [member wind_time] is a continuous time in seconds independent of accelerated TOD. Optional aerial perspective uses each reconstructed cloud sample's opacity-weighted representative depth. Against the sky it fades premultiplied cloud radiance and opacity together into the existing atmospheric sky, starting at [member aerial_start_distance] and fading before the finite trace boundary. Against opaque geometry, it retains cloud transmission and applies externally supplied linear HDR sky colors only to cloud radiance. Neither path fogs the background again. The geometry path is a finite-distance, two-direction approximation, not an atmosphere LUT or a sample of Godot's volumetric fog. Smooth aerial color updates do not reset history because this operation occurs after history reconstruction. When Forward+ provides a volumetric fog map, composition automatically samples its already integrated scattering and transmission once per contributing cloud pixel, after ordinary foreground fog. The sample depth is the opacity-weighted representative cloud distance in central-camera view depth, including clouds nearer than the fog volume's length. This is a single-depth approximation, separate from the conservative occupied-interval front used for occlusion. Sky pixels honor the environment's volumetric sky-affect value and legacy blending setting. This uses Godot's actual froxel result, introduces no additional fog march, and never applies fog again to the background. Fog lighting already includes exposure, so cloud exposure is not applied to it a second time. When the Environment analytic_fog mode is enabled, clouds use its shared analytic distance/height integral and atmospheric lighting for their new contribution only. Legacy foreground, froxel, and aerial approximations are bypassed; the finite trace-boundary opacity fade remains. The already-fogged background is not fogged again. In sparse Mode 0, true phase samples immediately replace history; untraced pixels retain a single source observation for at most eight frames. The phase order is 0,2,3,1 with a fixed spatial ray offset per quarter tile across all phases and later cycles. This avoids changing Monte Carlo ray noise when external TAA is disabled; it does not add temporal color averaging and can retain stationary sampling grain. Transmittance-weighted representative depths are stored separately from conservative occupied-interval fronts. Historical reprojection retains color and depth from one identical point sample, rejects incompatible min/max occlusion, and preserves the exact source age. Spatial reconstruction and final composition use bilinear filtering only in scene-depth-compatible neighborhoods; otherwise composition selects the best of four near/far endpoint pairs. Continuous coverage/density changes are a project extension, not a claim of arbitrary material-motion compensation.

method.name: get_diagnostics
method.description: Returns last rendered view diagnostics: supported, mode, trace_size, history_size, output_size, view_count, frame, history_valid, and reset_count. These fields describe CPU scheduling. Once completed GPU timestamps are available, gpu_time_ms reports the measured duration of the three cloud passes and gpu_timing_frame identifies that earlier completed frame. Timestamp labels include the effect and viewport IDs so concurrent views do not share measurements. This duration excludes any separate-specular renderer work required for MSAA composition.

method.name: get_wind_offset
method.description: Returns the accumulated world-space wind displacement in meters. Forward time increments integrate the current velocity; editing velocity does not move the field immediately. A time rewind or jump over one second deterministically seeks to velocity multiplied by the new time and resets history.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Rejects history on the next render, for camera switches, TOD jumps, and re-enabling the effect.

members.member: Trace every half-resolution pixel each frame instead of sparse quarter-resolution phases. Improves motion stability at higher GPU and memory cost. Switching reallocates trace textures and invalidates prior history. Default false preserves Mode 0.
Cloud-only aerial perspective strength in [0,1]. Zero preserves the previous composition. Editing this parameter resets history.

Characteristic aerial distance in meters, clamped to [100,200000]. Against the sky, cloud contribution decays after aerial_start_distance; it also fades between 65% and 95% of max_distance. Aerial strength continuously mixes this result with the original cloud composition. Editing this parameter resets history.

Distance in meters before sky-cloud exponential fading begins, clamped to [0,200000]. The separate finite-trace boundary fade remains tied to max_distance. Does not affect the geometry/near-prefix HDR aerial path. Editing this parameter resets history.
Linear HDR atmosphere color in the current horizontal viewing direction. Update from the TOD-driven atmosphere, without additional gamma conversion.
Linear HDR atmosphere color toward the zenith. Interpolated by view elevation; the approximation does not resolve the full directional solar lobe.

Optional dedicated density material. When set, its coverage, density, shape scale, textures, erosion, height profile, and albedo replace the legacy effect density controls. Layer geometry, wind and lighting remain on the effect. A null material preserves the procedural density fallback.
Cloud layer base altitude in meters.
Cloud shell thickness in meters.
Planet radius in meters.
Global coverage in [0, 1]. Continuous changes retain bounded history; changes greater than 0.1 between rendered frames reject history.
Peak extinction per meter. Continuous changes retain bounded history; changes greater than 25% of the larger old/new value (with a 0.00001 absolute floor) reject history.
Noise frequency per meter.
World-space wind velocity in meters per second.

Continuous wind clock in seconds. Forward increments of at most one second integrate current velocity into accumulated displacement. Velocity edits affect future intervals without repositioning the field. Reverse time and jumps over one second seek to velocity multiplied by the new time and reset history.
Normalized direction toward the sun.
Linear sunlight color at cloud altitude.
Sunlight energy before local foreground fog.
Linear ambient cloud illumination.
Single Henyey-Greenstein phase asymmetry in [-0.95, 0.95].
Bounded primary steps, 8 to 128.
Sunlight self-shadow steps per occupied primary sample, 1 to 12.
Maximum cloud ray distance in meters, independent of camera far plane.
Linear foreground fog scattering color. The already-fogged scene is not fogged twice.
Ordinary foreground-fog transmission applied to cloud radiance. Keep volumetric fog out of this scalar: the renderer's integrated froxel map is applied separately and automatically when present.
